response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang background, but is a poor fit for this embedded networking security role. He shows no native-level Japanese proficiency (a hard requirement), no Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, no L2/L3 networking or switch development background, and no security-technology experience (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption). His C experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments over a decade ago.
strengths: 15+ years of professional software development experience, well above the 3-year minimum
Some systems-level and low-latency experience (DLang async I/O, C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux)
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD) and demonstrated ability to learn diverse stacks
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed — native-level Japanese is a hard requirement
No embedded firmware, Linux kernel, network switch, or security-protocol (MACsec, 802.1X) experience
C/UNIX proficiency appears minimal and dated; career trajectory is web/full-stack, not embedded
